icon.description:
Throw a dynamite stick exploding 
when shot or after <hl>$duration$t</hl>. Deals
<dmg>$min_dmg$-$max_dmg$ $$ddmg$</dmg>, and inflicts <effect>Fire $$eeffect$</effect>
for <hl>$effect_duration$t</hl> to targets within <hl>$aoe_radius$m</hl>

<hl>+{{$charge_per_tick$*20}/$min_charge$} charge progress</hl> per second
<hl>+$charge_per_kill$% charge progress</hl> per <kill>kill $$kill$</kill>.
